chunks: Abu Basir said: I heard Abu Abdillah عليه السلام saying:
Excellent is the mosque, the Mosque of Kufa.
A thousand Prophets and a thousand successors prayed in it.
And from it, the oven gushed forth.
And in it the Ark was fashioned. Its right side is the good pleasure of Allah, its middle is a garden from the gardens of Paradise, and its left side is deceit, meaning the abodes of the devils.

key_terms.أَلْفُ نَبِيٍّ: a thousand Prophets who prayed in it
key_terms.رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ: a garden from the gardens of Paradise
key_terms.فَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ: the oven gushed forth, referring to the well-known Qur'anic sign in the story of Nuh
key_terms.مَسْجِدُ ٱلْكُوفَةِ: the Mosque of Kufa, praised here as a greatly virtuous mosque

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the virtue and sacred history of Masjid al-Kufah?
ai.summary: This hadith praises Masjid al-Kufah as a mosque of immense sanctity and sacred history. It connects the mosque with many Prophets and awsiya', with the Qur'anic event of the gushing oven, and with the construction of the Ark. It also describes distinct spiritual qualities associated with its sides and center, including a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
